<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>3D Humanoid Figure Animation</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script type="module">
        import * as THREE from './three.module.js';

        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        const humanoid = new THREE.Group();
        const bodyGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 0.5);
        const bodyMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x0000ff });
        const body = new THREE.Mesh(bodyGeo, bodyMat);
        humanoid.add(body);

        const limbs = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const limbGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.25, 1, 0.25);
            const limbMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x00ff00 });
            const limb = new THREE.Mesh(limbGeo, limbMat);
            limb.position.y = i < 2 ? 0.75 : -0.75;
            limb.position.x = i % 2 == 0 ? 0.5 : -0.5;
            humanoid.add(limb);
            limbs.push(limb);
        }

        scene.add(humanoid);
        camera.position.z = 5;

        const groundGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(10, 0.1, 10);
        const groundMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x808080 });
        const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeo, groundMat);
        ground.position.y = -1.5;
        scene.add(ground);

        let time = 0;
        const clock = new THREE.Clock();

        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            const delta = clock.getDelta();
            time += delta;

            const cycleTime = 10;
            const currentPhase = time % cycleTime;

            if (currentPhase < 2) {
                // Standing still
                humanoid.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
                limbs.forEach(limb => limb.rotation.set(0, 0, 0));
            } else if (currentPhase < 5) {
                // Walking
                const walkSpeed = Math.PI;
                humanoid.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
                limbs.forEach((limb, i) => {
                    const direction = i % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1;
                    limb.rotation.set(0, 0, Math.sin(time * walkSpeed) * direction * 0.5);
                });
            } else if (currentPhase < 8) {
                // Running
                const runSpeed = Math.PI * 2;
                humanoid.rotation.set(0, 0, -0.1);
                limbs.forEach((limb, i) => {
                    const direction = i % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1;
                    limb.rotation.set(0, 0, Math.sin(time * runSpeed) * direction);
                });
            } else {
                // Standing still
                humanoid.rotation.set(0, 0, 0);
                limbs.forEach(limb => limb.rotation.set(0, 0, 0));
            }

            ground.position.x += 0.05;
            if (ground.position.x > 5) {
                ground.position.x = -5;
            }

            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
